title: Model changes during a session, including a re-log of one message under another model
policy: P10: one operation has one model; a later record of the same message id + request id with another model doesn't add a second operation's tokens. Unverified whether Claude Code ever writes this; the identity rule belongs to the ADR in #9.
derivation: claude-test-1 [100, 10], Haiku 4.5 [200, 20], claude-test-2 [50, 5]; the re-log of msg_12a under claude-test-2 adds nothing: 385 tokens, 3 operations, Haiku cost 200 x $1/M + 20 x $5/M = $0.0003 known. Today the re-log's full counts go to claude-test-2 with no extra call: claude-test-2 [150, 15], 495 tokens.
